content.short: cMETA is an comming Metaverse on the Cardano Blockchain, you can buy and sell land, buildings and much more.
content.description:
cMETA is working on a metaverse based on the Cardano blockchain. It allows the trading of lands, islands, buildings and many other assets that can later be used in the metaverse.

cMETA started at the end of 2021 with the sale of islands, lands and META coins. These are available in Bronze, Silver and Gold. They are intended to represent a value similar to that in the real world, which can be used to buy various assets in the metaverse. cMETA was able to accrue a large audience in such a short amount of time because there is currently an enormous demand for Cardano metaverse projects. Many fans of the project can hardly wait for the metaverse to be available. The cMETA token was also recently released with a total stock of 210,000,000. The token can be traded via SundaeSwap. The cMETA token is intended to stabilize the project for the future and facilitate investment in cMETA, so that you can invest in cMETA with as little funding as you like, as opposed to buying lands or assets with set prices.

Currently, in addition to the NFT Land, which was previously only available in the form of Random Land, there is also the option of buying Direct Land Tickets. These tickets can be exchanged for land in a later development phase. In this phase, the buyer can select the country they desire directly on the map. With the Premium Land (Random) ticket, the buyer can later exchange the ticket in an identical manner. Here, however, the country is randomly selected, but in premium areas that are located near cities and portals of the Metaverse.

The random land that was sold in the presale will be automatically converted into premium land in the later development phase, so that early birds have a certain advantage, no matter what the value of the asset that was purchased. This does not affect the islands, as these were released under a new PolicyID after the presale.

cMETA is currently being developed with Unity. The map has already been created and can already be viewed online.
